Wince test: 'letters swapping' is the letters-move picture that many dyslexic adults call the outsider's myth (the difficulty is in sounding words out and holding spellings, not in letters moving); that is the clause they would wince at. Some do report it, so Roger may keep it.

entries.suggested_edit: This means reading with effort, sounding out what others take in at a glance, spellings never sticking, dreading being asked to read aloud, and learning by ear, by picture and by doing.

sets.name: sensitive attitudes
sets.review: One grain: each states the attitude held and voiced, no disclaimers, and each is written to keep off its policy or membership neighbour (elderly and young; antifeminist; anti_immigration). The one inconsistency is direction, ageist both ways and sexist one way, which is Roger's call. xenophobic carries a belief clause ('bring crime and take what is ours') and a wish ('wanting them gone') that the other two lack; that fits the word and is not a grain fault.

sets.name: social ties
sets.review: One grain (present conditions in household particulars) and a sensible shape: the bond, the want, and nobody to lean on, with isolated and well_connected already holding network size. lonely's opening leans onto isolated; the three tests separate them. close_knit may pair with lonely or unsupported at the check, as the writer expects; record what the check finds.

sets.name: states
sets.review: All three in the present with bodily particulars, per Roger's state exception, and sleep_deprived uses the packet's own phrase. The stressed/distressed line (demands outrunning capacity vs nerves and hopelessness with no demand named) is stated in the writer's nearest-existing lines and holds in the drafts. Both will likely check to calm; singletons expected.

sets.name: clinical and neurodivergence
sets.review: Inside voice throughout: no clinical vocabulary in any draft, each written as what the days, attention, feelings and dealings with others are like, none as deficits; one grain. The named neighbours (obsessive, paranoid, survivor) were read and the separations hold (act vs thought; a plot against all vs a threat to me; speaking from inside it vs from after). Two clauses to look at, both with edits above: delusional's 'against all proof' (the narrator's word) and dyslexic's 'letters swapping' (the clause a dyslexic reader may wince at).

summary: 35 drafts read against the packet, the queue entries and the neighbours (amoral, obsessive, paranoid, serene and turbulent, survivor, evangelist read in full; the other cited neighbours by description). All 35 pass form: 29-32 words, one sentence, 'This means' without label echo, US spelling, no partner named, no clinical vocabulary, and every membership passes the wince test except one clause. 29 ok, 6 edit: five with a corrected text (delusional's 'against all proof' is the narrator's word; dyslexic's 'letters swapping' is the wince clause; stoner's 'slow easy drawl' is above the notes; stigmatized punctuation; unscrupulous's 'knowing full well it is wrong' misfits the word and the DOSPERT sense) and one, mercenary, held for Roger with no rewrite: the queue's source is the neutral MVPI commerce motive and the draft is the vice. Roger's calls, left in the text as drafted: ageist both ways vs sexist one way; detractor trait vs role (evangelist is a role, so no cross-type pair); middle_aged's band; 'gun owner' and 'middle-class' label spelling; self_harming's two named methods; unscrupulous vs amoral (amoral's questions already hold the wallet and the taken credit; 'keep whichever generates better' as queued); and whether distressed, unscrupulous and mercenary, whose source fields name Kessler, DOSPERT and MVPI, are plain traits as the packet says or rule-9 standards entries. Convention in this file: an 'ok' entry may carry 'Roger's call' or 'Note' lines in issues and can be seeded as written; 'edit' means a text change is proposed or, for mercenary, the sense must be decided first.
